lines.t: Stardew Valley was made by one person, and it has sold over 50 million copies.
Eric Barone did the code, art, music and sound alone, for five years. One ranking even named it the best game for reducing stress.
It was almost called Sprout Valley, and it was inspired by Harvest Moon.
It sold a million copies in two months. There are 12 villagers you can marry, and fans have made over 30,000 mods.
